name: Kaberi Chattopadhyaya

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Kaberi Chattopadhyaya, published as Kaberi Chattopadhyay, grew up in Assam and taught English in West Bengal. Her writing includes the memoir Peeping Through My Window, the poetry collection The Twilight Bells and short fiction. Her publisher’s account connects an education at Calcutta University and North Eastern Hill University with a teaching career at Ramkrishna Vivekananda Mission and Army Public School, Barrackpore.

Her Kabita Live poems often pause at moments when a life changes its shape. ‘The silver bathed night’ observes a father facing retirement; ‘DUKHIRAM’ discovers a labouring boy’s lost childhood in a kaleidoscope. ‘Love`s First Rays’ attends to an unexpected awakening of affection, while ‘AS LIFE DEMANDS’ turns towards the ethical choices people make in a world of unequal joys and sorrows.
